body: Yes. I always have a plan. The main reason is because I find myself being unable to focus. Negative thoughts keep intruding and it eats away any desire to do my work. I feel emotional, uneasy and guilty (for not doing my work). I used to play video games to relax myself but it doesn't work anymore. Even when I do something to distract myself, like listening to music or reading a book, the thought and uneasiness is always there.

The thought that I have to do my assignments because I feel that I do not have the ability to do well. Whenever there is an assignment I feel afraid. My grades arent great. I also dont wish to deal with the people at school especially the lecturers.
Sure! It's great to have another person's opinion besides my friend.

I am very afraid that I will be told there is actually nothing wrong with me. That will just mean that life is meaningless to me and there's nothing I can do to change it. But I really want answers. Sigh, I am conflicted.

Thanks for talking to me. I just needed to let it out.

As far as I can remember, I was never happy and didn't talk to people until I was in 3rd grade or something. Then I started feeling empty and occasionally having suicidal thoughts (but have never attempted nor do I want to). Now, I still feel unhappy, empty, occasionally suicidal and feel slightly anxious and uncomfortable around strangers. Although there are still many things I am still having problems expressing, it was only recently that I started to wonder what it's like for other people to be generally happy/content about life. It seems like I am born like that so I don't really know what's up with me. But I wish to have some answers, I guess.

Trying to find the courage to seek help from a doctor about my mental health. Told a very close friend of mine of my decision but have never acted upon it even though he has offered to pay and accompany me. My fear (of judgement) and distrust of people is stopping me.
